description: This file contains extension methods for configuring Azure Cosmos DB persistence in an Orleans-based application. It provides various overloads for adding Cosmos grain storage with customizable options, including support for custom partition key providers, and integrates with dependency injection services.

classes.name: HostingExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring Cosmos DB storage in Orleans silo builders and service collections.

methods.name: AddCosmosGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Cosmos DB storage as the default grain storage with optional custom partition key provider.

methods.name: AddCosmosGrainStorage
methods.description: Adds Cosmos DB grain storage to the silo with specified options and optional custom partition key provider.
